question: Detected 2 uploaded invoices totalling RM 15,000.00 while the claim total declares RM 10,000.00. Clarify: (1) is one invoice a deposit voucher for another, or (2) was an invoice voided and reissued?
answer: Answered by Programme Operations Administrator: INV-PPR-2026-1201 (RM 10,000.00) is the final invoice; INV-PPR-2026-1188 is a deposit voucher that was voided and re-issued and must not be claimed. Partner to re-upload the declaration with the voided voucher removed.
